configuration.tbelScript: return 'RPC to device ' + metadata.deviceName + ' result: ' + JSON.stringify(msg);

var source = msg.get('values'); if (source == null) source = msg; var values = {}; if (source.get('temperature') != null) values.put('temperature', source.get('temperature')); if (source.get('humidity') != null) values.put('humidity', source.get('humidity')); if (source.get('co2') != null) values.put('co2', source.get('co2')); if (source.get('pm25') != null) values.put('pm25', source.get('pm25')); if (source.get('air_quality') != null) values.put('air_quality', source.get('air_quality')); if (source.get('seq') != null) values.put('seq', source.get('seq')); var record = {}; record.put('deviceName', metadata.get('deviceName')); record.put('location', metadata.get('location')); record.put('ts', metadata.get('ts')); record.put('values', values); return { msg: record, metadata: metadata, msgType: msgType };
